lines.plainText: And thus my battle shall be ordered

lines.text: My foreward shall be drawn out all in length,
lines.plainText: My foreward shall be drawn out all in length

lines.text: Consisting equally of horse and foot;
lines.plainText: Consisting equally of horse and foot

lines.text: Our archers shall be placed in the midst.
lines.plainText: Our archers shall be placed in the midst

lines.text: John Duke of Norfolk, Thomas Earl of Surrey,
lines.plainText: John Duke of Norfolk Thomas Earl of Surrey

lines.text: Shall have the leading of this foot and horse.
lines.plainText: Shall have the leading of this foot and horse

lines.text: They thus directed, we will follow
lines.plainText: They thus directed we will follow

lines.text: In the main battle, whose puissance on either side
lines.plainText: In the main battle whose puissance on either side

lines.text: Shall be well winged with our chiefest horse.
lines.plainText: Shall be well winged with our chiefest horse

lines.text: This, and Saint George to boot! What think'st thou, Norfolk?
lines.plainText: This and Saint George to boot What think'st thou Norfolk

lines.text: A good direction, warlike sovereign.
lines.plainText: A good direction warlike sovereign

lines.text: [Reads.] "Jockey of Norfolk, be not too bold.
lines.plainText: Reads Jockey of Norfolk be not too bold

lines.text: For Dickon thy master is bought and sold."
lines.plainText: For Dickon thy master is bought and sold

lines.text: A thing devised by the enemy.
lines.plainText: A thing devised by the enemy

lines.text: Go, gentlemen, every man unto his charge.
lines.plainText: Go gentlemen every man unto his charge

lines.text: Let not our babbling dreams affright our souls;
lines.plainText: Let not our babbling dreams affright our souls

lines.text: Conscience is but a word that cowards use,
lines.plainText: Conscience is but a word that cowards use

lines.text: Devised at first to keep the strong in awe.
lines.plainText: Devised at first to keep the strong in awe

lines.text: Our strong arms be our conscience, swords our law.
lines.plainText: Our strong arms be our conscience swords our law

lines.text: March on. Join bravely. Let us to it pell-mell,
lines.plainText: March on Join bravely Let us to it pellmell

lines.text: If not to heaven, then hand in hand to hell.
lines.plainText: If not to heaven then hand in hand to hell

lines.text: My lord, he doth deny to come.
lines.plainText: My lord he doth deny to come

lines.text: Off with his son George's head!
lines.plainText: Off with his son George's head

lines.text: My lord, the enemy is past the marsh.
lines.plainText: My lord the enemy is past the marsh

lines.text: After the battle let George Stanley die.
lines.plainText: After the battle let George Stanley die

lines.text: A thousand hearts are great within my bosom.
lines.plainText: A thousand hearts are great within my bosom

lines.text: Advance our standards! Set upon our foes!
lines.plainText: Advance our standards Set upon our foes

lines.text: Our ancient word of courage, fair Saint George,
lines.plainText: Our ancient word of courage fair Saint George

lines.text: Inspire us with the spleen of fiery dragons!
lines.plainText: Inspire us with the spleen of fiery dragons

lines.text: Upon them! Victory sits on our helms.
lines.plainText: Upon them Victory sits on our helms
